title: React Deployment Applied Check
description: Apply deployment knowledge to production build, Git, Docker, Netlify, Vercel, CI/CD, environment, and caching edge cases.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: A deployed SPA works at `/` but refreshing `/settings` returns 404 on Netlify. What is likely missing?

options.text: An SPA fallback redirect to the app entry point

questions.explanation: Static hosts need a fallback rule so client-side routes resolve to the SPA shell.

questions.prompt: A Docker image runs `npm run dev -- --host` in production. What is the main issue?

options.text: The development server is not the intended production serving path

questions.explanation: Production containers should serve optimized build output, not a dev server with development behavior.

questions.prompt: A new deployment still serves old JavaScript even after a successful build. Which area should you inspect first?

options.text: Cache headers, hashed asset references, and CDN invalidation behavior

questions.explanation: Stale production assets usually point to cache or CDN configuration problems.

questions.prompt: Which files or values should usually not be committed? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Generated build output unless the repo explicitly requires it
The package lockfile for an app

questions.explanation: Secrets and generated output usually do not belong in source; app lockfiles commonly should be committed.

questions.prompt: A Vercel app has correct routes locally but serverless API calls fail only in preview. What should you compare?

options.text: Preview environment variables and platform function configuration

questions.explanation: Preview and production environments can have different variables and serverless settings.

questions.prompt: A CI workflow caches `node_modules` broadly and intermittent dependency issues appear after lockfile changes. What is safer?

options.text: Key the cache by lockfile or cache the package manager store appropriately

questions.explanation: CI caches should be invalidated when dependency definitions change.

questions.prompt: A feature flag is compiled into the static bundle, then toggled in the hosting dashboard after deployment with no effect. Why?

options.text: The flag was build-time config, not runtime config
The flag needs an ARIA role

questions.explanation: Static frontend bundles cannot see changed build-time variables until rebuilt or supplied via runtime config.

questions.prompt: A team needs a rollback after a broken deployment. Which Git and release practice helps?

options.text: Tag releases and keep commits small enough to identify the bad change
Squash all history into one unreviewed commit

questions.explanation: Tags, reviewable commits, and release records make rollback and diagnosis easier.
